_comment: Hand-picked POIs that OpenStreetMap misses or tags in a way add_services.py does not match. Merged into the GPX and the day pages on every add_services run, and never thinned — if it is in here, somebody chose it deliberately. Keyed by day. type must be one of Water, Toilets, Food, Store, Scenic, Historic; sym is a Garmin symbol name.
